info.title: LMOxide API
info.description: Administration and status of an LMOxide (LEGO Minifigures Online) server.

get.summary: List accounts, by username. Scope: read.

X-Total-Count.description: How many accounts match the search in all

get.summary: One account with its characters. Scope: read.

delete.summary: Delete an account with its character and friendships (kicks it first). Scope: admin.

patch.summary: Rename an account or change its GM level (from its next login). Scope: admin.

post.summary: Ban an account and disconnect it. Scope: moderate.
Set or remove an account's password (ends its sessions). Scope: admin.
Lift an account's ban. Scope: moderate.
Create an API key (e.g. for a Discord bot); the secret is shown once. Scope: admin.

delete.summary: Revoke an API key. Scope: admin.

get.summary: Administrative actions, newest first. Scope: admin.

post.summary: Log in with a game account; returns a session token.

Trade the current session for a new one (a new token and expiry; the old token stops
working), so a remembered sign-in lasts while it is used. Banned accounts can't renew.
Send a chat line from "Server" to everyone online. Scope: moderate.

get.summary:
The client's animations: animation attributes (what `!anim <attribute>` plays), motion sets
and anim graphs. Scope: read.
The character states (`!state <value>`) and substates the client knows, by name. Scope: read.

The client's effect packages and particle systems: timelines, particles, sounds, animation
attributes, code hooks, Lua, and the items and spells that use them
(tools/re/extract_effect_catalog.py). Scope: read.

Every monster data (look) in the client, with its motion set, anim graph, death effect and
what uses it: the choices for `!skin <id>`. Scope: read.

A sound an effect package plays (`sounds[].id`), as Ogg Vorbis from the client's RDB (type
1020002). Needs `--client-dir`; 503 without it. Scope: read.

What the test commands accept: commands with usage, target kinds with their numbered targets,
test scenarios, dialogues, loot kinds, spawnable enemies and smashables, and monster data
looks (the game server's devcmd.rs). For tools that offer them as choices. Scope: read.
How this API is set up: registration, GM level thresholds.

post.summary: Switch maintenance mode: while on, only accounts with a GM level can log in. Scope: admin.
Change the logged-in account's password (ends its sessions).

get.summary: Every minifigure: name, attacks, upgrade names by bit, parts.
Characters in play, by in-game name.
get.description: Public unless the API runs with `--private-status`.

get.summary: Everyone logged in, with account details. Scope: read.

post.summary:
Run a test command (the game server's devcmd.rs: `!fx`, `!skin`, `!state`, `!tp`, ...) as the
player, as if typed in chat; the player's GM level still decides whether it runs. For tools
such as an effect browser that preview things in the game client. Scope: admin.

get.summary: Playfield ids in the other answers, with their names (worlds, dungeons, the LEGO Center).

get.description: Public unless the API runs with `--private-status`.

get.summary: Token ids (minifigure parts, as in `Character.tokens`) with their names.

oneOf.description: The ban in force, if any.

AnimGraph.description: RDB 1050003: an EMotion FX anim graph (blend setup).

attributes.description: Its parameters: the animation attributes it reacts to.

motions.description: The motion ids its nodes play.

AnimationCatalog.description:
Motion sets, anim graphs and the animation attributes effect packages set
(data/animations.json, tools/re/extract_animations.py).

ApiScope.description: What a credential may do; each includes the ones before it.

target.description: What the action was about; for accounts, the username at the time.

target_account_id.description: For actions on an account: its id (the account may since have been deleted).

until.description: Unix time the ban ends; `null`: permanent.

days.description: Length in days; permanent without it.

about.description: What the client does in it, where known.

groups.description: The action groups allowed in it.

BccStates.description:
The character states the client defines (stat 20, BCCState: `!state <value>`) and substates,
from its behaviour tree (data/bcc_states.json, tools/re/extract_bcc_states.py).

message.description: 1-500 characters, shown in every player's chat from "Server".

counters.description:
Achievement counters: stat -> minifigure template (0 = the player) -> value (stat 3000116
enemies defeated, 3000126 smashables smashed, 3000112/3000113 per-minifigure counters).

defeats.description: What the character defeated, by name (enemies, champions, bosses, smashables).

finds.description: Collectibles and places found ("<playfield>:<world object name>") -> unix time.

level.description:
Player level; 0 = never set (a game server without `--progression` plays every
character at level 30).

minifigure_ranks.description: Minifigure ranks (0..8) by item template, where set (`--progression`).

team.description: Minifigure item templates in team order (the first is active).

tokens.description: Token counters (minifigure parts): token id -> gained, spent.

upgrades.description: Active upgrade bitmask per minifigure template.

saved_at.description: Unix time of the last save.

command.description: A test command as typed in chat, e.g. `!fx 163540`, `!skin 2212`, `!state 29`.

affected.description: How many players it reached (0: not online).

replies.description:
What the server answered in the player's chat while running it (e.g. `effect package
1748 (12 of 2518)`, a usage line, `Test commands need a GM level.`). Lines that come
later (after a teleport, during a dialogue) aren't here.

secret.description: The secret, shown only now: send as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`.

first_at.description: Unix times of the first and the last.

name.description: Its name in the client data, e.g. "Global_Smash 1000 Monsters" (empty if unknown).

allOf.description:
What EffectPackageIIR plays (`!fx <id>`): timelines of particles, sounds, animation
attributes, Lua, ... Packages have no names of their own: `used_by` names them.

oneOf.description:
What EffectPackageIIR plays (`!fx <id>`): timelines of particles, sounds, animation
attributes, Lua, ... Packages have no names of their own: `used_by` names them.

allOf.description: A particle effect packages refer to by resource name.

oneOf.description: A particle effect packages refer to by resource name.

EffectCatalog.description:
The client's effect packages and particle systems (data/effect_catalog.json,
tools/re/extract_effect_catalog.py).

code_hooks.description: Code hooks its timelines start at (`onhit`, `charge`, `execute`, ...): `!fx <id> <hook>`.

reason.description: Shown to the player in chat.

remember.description:
Stay signed in: the session lasts `--remember-days` instead of `--session-ttl-hours`
(for a token kept across browser restarts; renew it with `/v1/auth/renew`).

names.description: Names of the characters with this look.

MonsterCatalog.description:
Every monster data (RDB 1010514): the looks `!skin <id>` takes (data/monster_data.json,
tools/re/extract_monster_data.py).

anim_graph.description: Its anim graph (`anim_graphs`): which animation attributes it reacts to.

death_effect_package.description: The effect package played when it is defeated.

minifigures.description: Minifigure item templates with this body (GET /v1/minifigures).

used_by.description: What the world places with this look.

MotionSet.description: RDB 1050004: a look's motions by id.

password.description: Without one the account can't log in until a password is set.

id.description: RDB 1010207 id (`null`: not in the client's name index).

name.description: Resource name (`null`: a package names it by id and the index has no name for it).

teleport.description: A `!tp` destination (with an arrival point); the others are the tutorial, layers, test maps.

PublicPlayer.description: A player as anyone may see them (in-game names only).

remember.description: As in the login: a long session (`--remember-days`) or a short one.

ServerConfig.description: How this API is set up, for clients that adapt to it (always public).

admin_gm_level.description: GM level from which an account's login session has the admin scope.

moderator_gm_level.description: GM level from which an account's login session has the moderate scope.

private_status.description: Whether `/v1/status` and `/v1/online` need a read-scope credential (`--private-status`).

oneOf.description: `null`: the account may only see and change itself (`/v1/me`).

password.description: `null` removes the password (the account can't log in).

id.description: RDB 1020002 id (Ogg Vorbis): GET /v1/catalog/sounds/{id}. `null`: not in the client.

path.description: As the package names it, e.g. `sfx\swishes\swish_blade_throw_1.wav`.

started_at.description: Unix time the game server started.

TestCatalog.description:
What the test commands accept, for tools that offer them as choices (the game server's
devcmd.rs). Targets and spawnable names come from the world as loaded; their numbers are
what `!goto <kind> <n>`, `!test <n>` and `!dialog <n>` take.

looks.description: `!skin <monster data>`: the looks of the world's characters and smashables

team.description: Minifigure names of the team it sets, the first active; empty: the team stays.

Timeline.description: One part of a package: a particle, a sound, an animation attribute, Lua, ...

duration.description:
Seconds; `null` when the part sets none (it lasts as long as its content, e.g. a sound)
or lasts until the package is stopped (`until_stopped`). 0: an instant (Lua, an attribute).

hook.description: The code hook that starts this part's timeline (`null`: when the package starts).

start.description: Seconds after the package (or its code hook) starts.

target.description: self, target, client, ground, other, mount.

type.description: particle, sound, emotionfxattribute, lua, environmenteffect, movement, camerapath, ...

until_stopped.description: The designers' "forever": it lasts until the package is stopped.

minifigure.description: The minifigure this is a part of.

UsedBy.description:
An item template (RDB 1000620) or spell (1000621) whose data mention the id (a byte search:
a few may be coincidences).

first_at.description: Unix times of the first and the last.

bearer.description: An API key or a session token from /v1/auth/login (both start with lmox_)
